name: Panera Bread Plain Bagel (Order Plain / Butter)
whyItWorks: Freshly baked artisan plain bagel made from unbleached enriched flour. Contains zero sesame or poppy seeds, zero onion flakes, and provides convenient, dense, low-residue calories when traveling.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at Panera: "One Plain Bagel, sliced and toasted, with plain cream cheese or butter packet on the side."
